title: Tom and His Dog
text:
Tom has a small dog. The dog is brown and very fast. Every morning, Tom takes the dog to the park.

One day, the dog runs away. Tom looks for him all afternoon. In the end, he finds the dog under a big tree.

questions.text: Where does Tom find the dog?
How does Tom probably feel at the end of the story?
Why does Tom look for the dog all afternoon?
options: He wants to find his dog.
He wants to go to school.
He is tired of the park.

vocabulary.definition: the color of chocolate or wood
a place outside with grass and trees where people walk and play
the part of the day between lunch and evening

paragraph_translations: Tom tiene un perro pequeño. El perro es marrón y muy rápido. Cada mañana, Tom lleva al perro al parque.
Un día, el perro se escapa. Tom lo busca toda la tarde. Al final, encuentra al perro debajo de un árbol grande.
